criteria.name: uses_hanyu_deck_structure
criteria.description: Uses .slide > .canvas + aside with one .ns and one .nc block per page.

criteria.name: plain_speaker_script
criteria.description: Speaker scripts pair Chinese and English in natural paragraphs rather than a forced purpose/main/sub outline.

criteria.name: language_policy
criteria.description: Non-content deck UI and hover help use English; important slide information is concise Chinese-English bilingual content.

criteria.name: optional_notes
criteria.description: Notes are optional, retain content when hidden, and use a separate deck-scoped localStorage state.

criteria.name: local_only_phone
criteria.description: Phone prompting uses same-LAN transport and contains no public relay, MQTT, or hosted prompt page.

criteria.name: visual_system
criteria.description: The result uses the restrained 1920×1080 visual system and reuses suitable page patterns.

criteria.name: export_contract
criteria.description: Provides full-script export and changed-notes copy with the agreed labels.
